text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain-based oil and gas company, Intoil, posts a record $4 million profit in 1996, up 21 percent on the previous year.
- Bahrain Stock Exchange index ends at 1520.71 points in March, an increase of 28.19 points from February.
- Bahrain Aluminium Extrusion Company completes a 4.3 million dinar expansion project.
- Bahrain-China trade volume rises to $43 million in 1996.
- Bahrain Commercial Facilities Company's net profit rises to 1.1 million dinars in 1996 from 610,000 dinars in 1995.
- A fire broke out in a pet shop on Sunday. Investigators suspect arson.
